common.name: position
common.doc: Position relative to the parent, in pixels (+y is down).

common.name: rotation
common.doc: Rotation relative to the parent, in degrees (clockwise).

common.name: scale
common.doc: Size multiplier relative to the parent (1, 1 = as is; negative flips).

common.name: origin
common.doc: Where in the image the position is, and what it rotates and scales around: a fraction of its size (0.5, 0.5 = the centre, 0, 0 = the top-left, 0.5, 1 = the bottom centre).

common.name: layer
common.doc: Drawing layer: higher layers draw over lower ones (Layer8 is for UI).

common.name: zIndex
common.doc: Draw order within the layer, added to the parent's: higher draws on top (-10, 0, 10...); equal ones keep the tree order.

common.name: ySort
common.doc: Draw the children by their Y position (lower on screen = in front), each with its children: top-down and isometric depth.

common.name: ySortOffset
common.doc: Added to this node's Y when its parent Y-sorts: move the sorting line to the feet (e.g. half the sprite's height).

common.name: pauseMode
common.doc: Inherit the parent's pausing, Pausable (stops when paused) or Always (keeps running, e.g. pause menus).

common.name: paused
common.doc: Pauses this node and its children (except Always ones) while the game runs.

common.name: enabled
common.doc: Disabled nodes (and their children) neither update nor draw.

nodes.name: Empty Node
nodes.description: Basic 2D transform node with position, rotation, scale, and hierarchy grouping.

nodes.name: Camera 2D
nodes.description: 2D Camera viewport controller supporting target tracking, zoom levels, rotation, and screen offsets.

properties.name: isCurrent
properties.doc: The camera the game renders through (one per scene).

properties.name: followMode
properties.doc: Static: stays put. Single Target: follows its Follow Target. Multi Target: frames all targets. Manual: moved by scripts.

properties.name: dragType
properties.doc: How the camera catches up with its target: none (locked), smooth damp, spring, look-ahead (leads by the target's velocity) or auto speed.

properties.name: targetPosition
properties.doc: Where the camera is heading (world px).

properties.name: currentPosition
properties.doc: Where the camera is now (world px).

properties.name: smoothDrag
properties.doc: Ease towards the target instead of snapping.

properties.name: smoothDragSpeed
properties.doc: Smooth-damp time per axis (s): higher lags more.

properties.name: springConstant
properties.doc: Spring Damp: stiffness pulling the camera to the target.

properties.name: dampingRatio
properties.doc: Spring Damp: 1 settles without overshoot, lower wobbles.

properties.name: predictionTime
properties.doc: Look Ahead: how far ahead of the target to aim, in seconds of its velocity.

properties.name: maxDistance
properties.doc: Reserved (not used yet).

properties.name: offset
properties.doc: Added to the target position (world px).

properties.name: smoothOffset
properties.doc: Ease offset changes in.

properties.name: smoothOffsetSpeed
properties.doc: How fast offset changes ease in.

properties.name: screenOffset
properties.doc: Where on screen the camera's position appears (px; half the window = centred).

properties.name: currentRotation
properties.doc: The camera's rotation now (degrees).

properties.name: targetRotation
properties.doc: Rotation the camera turns to (degrees).

properties.name: allowRotation
properties.doc: Let the camera rotate (else it stays upright).

properties.name: smoothRotation
properties.doc: Ease rotation changes in.

properties.name: smoothRotationSpeed
properties.doc: How fast rotation eases in.

properties.name: zoom
properties.doc: Zoom now (1 = 100%, 2 = everything twice as big).

properties.name: targetZoom
properties.doc: Zoom the camera eases to.

properties.name: smoothZoom
properties.doc: Ease zoom changes in.

properties.name: smoothZoomSpeed
properties.doc: How fast zoom eases in.

properties.name: minZoom
properties.doc: Smallest zoom (auto zoom and scripts).

properties.name: maxZoom
properties.doc: Largest zoom (auto zoom and scripts).

properties.name: autoZoom
properties.doc: Multi Target: zoom out to keep every target on screen.

properties.name: zoomMargin
properties.doc: Auto zoom: extra space around the targets (0.1 = 10%).

properties.name: hasLimits
properties.doc: Keep the view inside the left / right / top / bottom limits.

properties.name: smoothLimit
properties.doc: Ease into the limits instead of stopping hard.

properties.name: leftLimit
properties.doc: Left edge the view may not pass (world px).

properties.name: rightLimit
properties.doc: Right edge the view may not pass (world px).

properties.name: topLimit
properties.doc: Top edge the view may not pass (world px).

properties.name: bottomLimit
properties.doc: Bottom edge the view may not pass (world px).

properties.name: useHMargins
properties.doc: Dead zone: the target moves freely between the left / right margins before the camera follows.

properties.name: useVMargins
properties.doc: Dead zone: the target moves freely between the top / bottom margins before the camera follows.

properties.name: leftMargin
properties.doc: Left dead-zone margin (fraction of the screen).

properties.name: rightMargin
properties.doc: Right dead-zone margin (fraction of the screen).

properties.name: topMargin
properties.doc: Top dead-zone margin (fraction of the screen).

properties.name: bottomMargin
properties.doc: Bottom dead-zone margin (fraction of the screen).

properties.name: enableMouseFollow
properties.doc: Nudge the camera towards the mouse.

properties.name: mouseInfluence
properties.doc: How much the mouse pulls the camera per axis (0-1).

properties.name: shakePreset
properties.doc: Ready-made shake (gunshot, earthquake...); Custom uses the settings below.

properties.name: shakeTypes
properties.doc: Custom shake: which motions combine.

properties.name: isShaking
properties.doc: A shake is running.

properties.name: shakeSpeed
properties.doc: Custom shake: how fast it shakes.

properties.name: shakeIntensity
properties.doc: Custom shake: how far it moves (px).

properties.name: shakeTrauma
properties.doc: Shake strength now (0-1); decays over time.

nodes.name: Timer
nodes.description: Periodic and one-shot countdown timer node for delayed actions and recurring intervals.

nodes.name: Lua Script Node
nodes.description: Dedicated Lua scripted node that automatically executes lifecycle callbacks (ready, update, render).

nodes.name: Texture Sprite
nodes.description: 2D textured sprite quad with texture mapping, tinting, origin offsets, and flipping.

properties.name: tint
properties.doc: Multiplies the texture's colours (white = unchanged; alpha fades it).

nodes.name: Atlas Sprite
nodes.description: 2D textured sprite displaying a sub-region (atlas / sheet slice) of a texture.

properties.name: tint
properties.doc: Multiplies the texture's colours (white = unchanged; alpha fades it).

nodes.name: Frame Animator
nodes.description: Sprite sheet frame-by-frame animator with configurable frame durations, loops, and ping-pong modes.

nodes.name: Animation Player
nodes.description: Keyframe animation sequencer supporting property tracks, transitions, and timeline scrubbing.

properties.name: reverse
properties.doc: Play the animation backwards.

properties.name: autoplay
properties.doc: Start playing the current animation when the node becomes ready.

nodes.name: Aseprite Sprite
nodes.description: An Aseprite file (.aseprite / .ase) played as Aseprite does: tags, directions, repeats, frame durations; layers on / off, slices and user data for scripts. Saving in Aseprite updates it live.

properties.name: file
properties.doc: The Aseprite file (.aseprite / .ase, project-relative). Saving it in Aseprite updates the node, in the editor and in a running game.

properties.name: animation
properties.doc: The tag played (its direction and repeat count as set in Aseprite); empty = every frame in order.

properties.name: autoplay
properties.doc: Start the animation when the node becomes ready.

properties.name: loop
properties.doc: Tags without a repeat count loop; off: they play once.

properties.name: speed
properties.doc: Playback speed (1 = the frame durations set in Aseprite).

properties.name: frame
properties.doc: The frame shown (0-based): where playing starts, or where it stopped.

properties.name: hideLayers
properties.doc: Layers not drawn (names, comma separated; a group hides its layers).

properties.name: showLayers
properties.doc: Layers hidden in the file but drawn anyway (names, comma separated).

properties.name: pivotSlice
properties.doc: A slice with a pivot (set in Aseprite): the node's origin follows it, frame by frame. Empty = the node's pivot.

properties.name: tint
properties.doc: Multiplies the sprite's colours.

nodes.name: State Machine
nodes.description: States, transitions and conditions on parameters; each state can play an animation on an AnimationPlayer. Scripts get on_enter_<state> / on_exit_<state>.

nodes.name: Particle Emitter
nodes.description: 2D particle burst and fountain generator with customizable speed, spread, lifetime, and colors.

properties.name: emitter.amount
properties.doc: Particles alive at once (the pool size).

properties.name: emitter.lifetime
properties.doc: Seconds each particle lives.

properties.name: emitter.position
properties.doc: Emitter position (follows the node).

properties.name: emitter.burst
properties.doc: 0 spreads emission evenly over the lifetime, 1 releases every particle at once.

properties.name: emitter.size
properties.doc: Particle size (px).

properties.name: emitter.sizeVariance
properties.doc: How much of Size Spread is applied at random (0-1).

properties.name: emitter.sizeSpread
properties.doc: Largest random size change (px).

properties.name: emitter.scaleStart
properties.doc: Scale at birth (multiplies Size).

properties.name: emitter.scaleEnd
properties.doc: Scale at death; it interpolates over the lifetime.

properties.name: emitter.rotation
properties.doc: Starting rotation (degrees).

properties.name: emitter.rotationVariance
properties.doc: How much of Rotation Spread is applied at random (0-1).

properties.name: emitter.rotationSpread
properties.doc: Largest random rotation change (degrees).

properties.name: emitter.torque
properties.doc: Spin speed (degrees/s).

properties.name: emitter.torqueVariance
properties.doc: How much of Torque Spread is applied at random (0-1).

properties.name: emitter.torqueSpread
properties.doc: Largest random spin change (degrees/s).

properties.name: emitter.torqueAcceleration
properties.doc: Change in spin speed per second.

properties.name: emitter.useColorRamp
properties.doc: Colour over the lifetime from the colour ramp (else Particle Color to Color End).

properties.name: emitter.particleColor
properties.doc: Colour at birth.

properties.name: emitter.colorEnd
properties.doc: Colour at death.

properties.name: emitter.colorVariance
properties.doc: Random colour variation (0-1).

properties.name: emitter.spread
properties.doc: Particles start anywhere within ± this box around the emitter (px).

properties.name: emitter.velocity
properties.doc: Starting speed (px/s).

properties.name: emitter.velocityVariance
properties.doc: How much of Velocity Spread is applied at random (0-1).

properties.name: emitter.velocitySpread
properties.doc: Largest random speed change (px/s).

properties.name: emitter.velocityScale
properties.doc: Multiplies every particle's movement (slow motion < 1).

properties.name: emitter.acceleration
properties.doc: Change in speed per second along the direction of travel.

properties.name: emitter.angle
properties.doc: Emission direction (degrees; 0 = right, 90 = down).

properties.name: emitter.angleVariance
properties.doc: How much of Angle Spread is applied at random (0-1).

properties.name: emitter.angleSpread
properties.doc: Largest random change to the angle (± degrees; 180 = all round).

properties.name: emitter.gravityDirection
properties.doc: Direction gravity pulls particles.

properties.name: emitter.gravityVelocity
properties.doc: Strength of that gravity (px/s²).

properties.name: emitter.wind
properties.doc: Constant drift added to every particle (px/s).

properties.name: emitter.collisionEnabled
properties.doc: Particles bounce off physics colliders.

properties.name: emitter.elasticity
properties.doc: Bounciness when colliding (0 stops, 1 keeps all speed).

properties.name: emitter.shape
properties.doc: Shape each particle is drawn as.

properties.name: emitter.emitting
properties.doc: Emit new particles (existing ones finish their lives).

properties.name: emitter.continuous
properties.doc: Keep emitting (else one cycle, then stop).

nodes.name: Sound Effect
nodes.description: Audio emitter for one-shot and recurring sound effects (.wav, .ogg) with volume and pitch control.

properties.name: volume
properties.doc: Volume (0-1), before the bus and master volumes.

properties.name: pitch
properties.doc: Playback speed / pitch (1 = normal).

properties.name: bus
properties.doc: The mixer bus it plays into (the Mixer tab; empty = SFX): its fader, effects and output apply.

properties.name: caption
properties.doc: Shown on the subtitle track when it plays, for players with sound captions on (e.g. "[door creaks]").

properties.name: autoplay
properties.doc: Play once when the node becomes ready.

properties.name: voices
properties.doc: Plays over itself up to this many times (1: a new play restarts it).

properties.name: positional
properties.doc: Volume and pan follow the node's distance and side from the listener (the current camera).

properties.name: minDistance
properties.doc: Positional: full volume within this distance (px).

properties.name: maxDistance
properties.doc: Positional: silent beyond this distance (px).

nodes.name: Music Streamer
nodes.description: Background streaming music player with seamless looping, crossfading, and volume attenuation.

properties.name: volume
properties.doc: Volume (0-1), before the bus and master volumes.

properties.name: pitch
properties.doc: Playback speed / pitch (1 = normal).

properties.name: pan
properties.doc: Stereo position: 0 left, 0.5 centre, 1 right.

properties.name: bus
properties.doc: The mixer bus it plays into (the Mixer tab; empty = Music): its fader, effects and output apply.

properties.name: caption
properties.doc: Shown on the subtitle track when it starts, for players with sound captions on (e.g. "[calm music]").

properties.name: looping
properties.doc: Start again at the end.

properties.name: autoplay
properties.doc: Start playing when the node becomes ready.

properties.name: isPlaying
properties.doc: Playing now.

properties.name: isPaused
properties.doc: Paused now.

nodes.name: Static Platform
nodes.description: Static immovable collision body that dynamic bodies collide with; perfect for ground, walls, and terrain.

properties.name: debugColor
properties.doc: Colour of the collider outline drawn with Show Bounds & Colliders (and the game's debug draw).

properties.name: oneWay
properties.doc: Jump-through platform: bodies pass from below and land on top.

nodes.name: Dynamic Physics Box
nodes.description: Box2D dynamic rigid body affected by gravity, physical impulses, forces, friction, and bounce.

properties.name: linearVelocity
properties.doc: Velocity (px/s).

properties.name: angularVelocity
properties.doc: Spin (degrees/s).

properties.name: linearDamping
properties.doc: Slows movement over time (air drag).

properties.name: angularDamping
properties.doc: Slows spin over time.

properties.name: gravityScale
properties.doc: Multiplies the world's gravity for this body (0 floats, negative rises).

properties.name: sleepThreshold
properties.doc: Below this speed the body may sleep (px/s).

properties.name: enableSleep
properties.doc: Let the body sleep when at rest (saves time; contacts wake it).

properties.name: isAwake
properties.doc: Awake (simulated) now.

properties.name: fixedRotation
properties.doc: Never rotate (characters, upright crates).

properties.name: isBullet
properties.doc: Continuous collision against other moving bodies (fast projectiles).

properties.name: allowFastRotation
properties.doc: Allow very fast spin (wheels); can be less stable.

properties.name: debugColor
properties.doc: Colour of the collider outline drawn with Show Bounds & Colliders (and the game's debug draw).

nodes.name: Character Mover
nodes.description: Kinematic character controller with smooth velocity integration, slope climbing, and ground snapping.

properties.name: radius
properties.doc: Capsule radius (px).

properties.name: height
properties.doc: Capsule height (px).

properties.name: velocity
properties.doc: Velocity now (px/s).

properties.name: targetSpeedX
properties.doc: Horizontal speed the built-in movement accelerates to (px/s).

properties.name: maxSpeed
properties.doc: Top running speed (px/s).

properties.name: acceleration
properties.doc: How quickly it reaches top speed (px/s²).

properties.name: jumpSpeed
properties.doc: Upward speed of a jump (px/s).

properties.name: gravityScale
properties.doc: Multiplies the world's gravity for the character.

properties.name: pushLimit
properties.doc: Most push per step from overlapping bodies (px/s; 0 = unlimited).

properties.name: clipVelocity
properties.doc: Remove velocity into walls and floors it hits (slide along them).

properties.name: enableKeyboardInput
properties.doc: Built-in movement: the move / jump input actions drive it.

properties.name: playerIndex
properties.doc: Player whose actions drive this mover (1..4; 0 = none / NPC / AI).

properties.name: isGrounded
properties.doc: Standing on something now.

properties.name: categoryLayers
properties.doc: Collision layers this object is on (names in Project Settings > Physics).

properties.name: maskLayers
properties.doc: Collision layers this object collides with.

properties.name: debugColor
properties.doc: Colour of the collider outline drawn with Show Bounds & Colliders (and the game's debug draw).

properties.name: controlMode
properties.doc: Built-in movement, or Script: the script moves it (character_move_and_slide).

nodes.name: Trigger Area
nodes.description: Physics detection volume that triggers onEnter and onExit overlap events without rigid collisions.

properties.name: overlapCount
properties.doc: Bodies overlapping now.

properties.name: hasOverlaps
properties.doc: Anything overlapping now.

properties.name: debugColor
properties.doc: Outline colour when nothing overlaps.

properties.name: activeColor
properties.doc: Outline colour while something overlaps.

nodes.name: Raycast Sensor
nodes.description: Directional line-of-sight raycaster detecting intersection points, surface normals, and hit fractions.

properties.name: direction
properties.doc: Direction of the ray (rotated with the node).

properties.name: length
properties.doc: Length of the ray (px).

properties.name: collideWithSensors
properties.doc: Sensor shapes (areas) also stop the ray.

properties.name: categoryLayers
properties.doc: Collision layers this object is on (names in Project Settings > Physics).

properties.name: maskLayers
properties.doc: Collision layers this object collides with.

properties.name: isColliding
properties.doc: The ray hit something this frame.

properties.name: hitFraction
properties.doc: Where along the ray it hit (0 start, 1 end).

properties.name: hitPoint
properties.doc: World point of the hit (px).

properties.name: hitNormal
properties.doc: Surface direction at the hit.

properties.name: rayColor
properties.doc: Ray colour when it hits nothing.

properties.name: hitColor
properties.doc: Ray colour when it hits.

nodes.name: Visibility Notifier
nodes.description: Knows when the camera sees a rectangle: screen_entered / screen_exited, and can pause, disable or remove its parent off screen (enemies wake up, bullets despawn).

properties.name: size
properties.doc: The rectangle (centred on the node, scaled with it) the camera has to see.

properties.name: margin
properties.doc: Grows the camera's view by this many pixels: fires a little before it really shows.

properties.name: action
properties.doc: What happens to the parent off screen: Pause (stops updating, resumes when seen), Disable (also stops drawing), Remove (freed once it was seen and left).

properties.name: onScreen
properties.doc: The camera sees it now (runtime, read-only).

nodes.name: Skeleton
nodes.description: Skeletal (cutout) animation from Spine or DragonBones exports: bones, meshes, skins, IK, events; crossfades; scripts can turn bones.

properties.name: file
properties.doc: The skeleton: a Spine .json export or a DragonBones _ske.json (project-relative).

properties.name: atlas
properties.doc: Its texture atlas; empty = next to it (name.atlas for Spine, name_tex.json for DragonBones).

properties.name: armature
properties.doc: DragonBones: the armature to show (empty = the first).

properties.name: animation
properties.doc: The animation played when the scene starts (and shown in the editor).

properties.name: skin
properties.doc: The skin (attachment set); empty = the default skin.

properties.name: loop
properties.doc: Play the animation over and over.

properties.name: autoplay
properties.doc: Start the animation when the node becomes ready.

properties.name: speed
properties.doc: Playback speed (1 = as authored).

properties.name: mixTime
properties.doc: Seconds to crossfade from one animation to the next.

properties.name: tint
properties.doc: Multiplies every slot's colour.

properties.name: showBones
properties.doc: Draw the bones over the art (also in the game, for debugging).

nodes.name: Bone Attachment
nodes.description: Under a Skeleton: follows one of its bones - put a weapon, a light or particles under it.

properties.name: bone
properties.doc: The parent skeleton's bone this node follows (its children ride along: a weapon in the hand).

properties.name: followRotation
properties.doc: Turn with the bone.

properties.name: followScale
properties.doc: Scale with the bone.

nodes.name: Advanced Camera
nodes.description: A virtual camera (Phantom Camera style): follow modes (glued, damped with look-ahead, group with auto-zoom, path, dead zone), limits incl. the LDtk level the target is in, trauma shake. The highest priority one is shown; switching blends.

properties.name: priority
properties.doc: The host camera shows the enabled advanced camera with the highest priority (a tie: the one added last); raise it to switch.

properties.name: followMode
properties.doc: None (stays where placed), Glued (exactly on the target), Simple (offset, damping, look-ahead), Group (frames all targets, auto-zoom), Path (on a PathNode, closest to the target), Framed (moves only when the target leaves the dead zone).

properties.name: followTarget
properties.doc: The node it follows (a path like Player or ../Hero).

properties.name: followTargets
properties.doc: Group: more nodes to frame, comma separated.

properties.name: followPath
properties.doc: Path: the PathNode the camera rides along.

properties.name: followOffset
properties.doc: Added to the target's position (px).

properties.name: damping
properties.doc: Smoothing time in seconds: 0 locks on, 0.2-0.5 feels smooth.

properties.name: axisLock
properties.doc: Don't follow along these axes (e.g. Y for a side-scroller that never moves vertically).

properties.name: lookahead
properties.doc: Looks ahead of a moving target by this many seconds of its velocity.

properties.name: deadZone
properties.doc: Framed: the part of the view (fraction of width / height) the target can move in without the camera moving.

properties.name: zoom
properties.doc: Zoom (2 = twice as close).

properties.name: autoZoom
properties.doc: Group: zoom so every target fits, between Auto Zoom Min and Max.

properties.name: autoZoomMin
properties.doc: Group auto zoom: farthest out.

properties.name: autoZoomMax
properties.doc: Group auto zoom: closest in.

properties.name: autoZoomMargin
properties.doc: Group auto zoom: space kept around the targets (px).

properties.name: limitMode
properties.doc: Keeps the view inside: None, Rect (Limit Rect), Node (a TileMap / LDtk level / Navigation Region / StaticBody's bounds), Ldtk Level (the LDtk level the target is in - changes as it walks into linked levels).

properties.name: limitNode
properties.doc: Node limits: the node whose bounds the view stays in.

properties.name: limitMargin
properties.doc: Shrinks (+) or grows (-) the limits (px).

properties.name: limitBlend
properties.doc: Seconds to glide to new limits (moving into another LDtk level); 0 = at once.

properties.name: blendTime
properties.doc: Seconds the host takes to move from the previous camera to this one when it becomes active.

properties.name: blendEase
properties.doc: The easing of that blend.

properties.name: snapToPixel
properties.doc: Round the position to whole pixels (pixel art).

properties.name: shakeIntensity
properties.doc: Shake offset at full trauma (px).

properties.name: shakeRotation
properties.doc: Shake rotation at full trauma (degrees).

properties.name: shakeDecay
properties.doc: Trauma lost per second.

properties.name: shakeFrequency
properties.doc: How fast the shake moves (noise speed).

properties.name: traumaExponent
properties.doc: Shake = trauma ^ exponent: 2-3 makes small hits subtle and big ones strong.

properties.name: trauma
properties.doc: Current trauma 0..1 (add_trauma stacks it; runtime).

properties.name: active
properties.doc: The host camera shows this one now (runtime, read-only).

nodes.name: Path
nodes.description: A curve through points with Bézier handles, edited in the viewport: routes, rails, moving platforms' tracks, camera paths. Add a Path Follow under it.

properties.name: closed
properties.doc: Join the last point back to the first (a loop).

properties.name: bakeInterval
properties.doc: Distance between the points the curve is turned into (px): smaller follows the curve more closely.

properties.name: lineWidth
properties.doc: Draw the path in the game this wide (rails, ropes); 0 = invisible (the editor always shows it).

properties.name: color
properties.doc: Colour of the drawn path (and of its outline in the editor).

nodes.name: Navigation Region
nodes.description: An area agents find paths in: baked into a grid from static bodies, solid tile maps and LDtk Solid cells. Bake in the Inspector; scripts can block cells (doors).

properties.name: size
properties.doc: The area agents find paths in, from the node's position (px).

properties.name: cellSize
properties.doc: Size of a grid cell (px): smaller follows walls more closely, larger finds paths faster.

properties.name: usePhysics
properties.doc: Static bodies' collision shapes inside the area block.

properties.name: useTileMaps
properties.doc: Solid tile maps' painted tiles block.

properties.name: useLdtk
properties.doc: LDtk IntGrid cells with a Solid collision rule block.

nodes.name: Navigation Agent
nodes.description: Put it under a character: give it a target and it walks there along a path, around walls and other agents (moves a CharacterMover, a DynamicBody or any node).

properties.name: speed
properties.doc: How fast it moves along its path (px/s).

properties.name: radius
properties.doc: Its size: paths keep this far from walls, and agents keep this far apart.

properties.name: arriveDistance
properties.doc: How close to the target counts as arrived (px).

properties.name: repathInterval
properties.doc: Seconds between new paths while moving (a moving target, opened doors); 0 = only when the target changes.

properties.name: navMap
properties.doc: The NavigationRegion, TileMap or LDtk level to find paths in (a node path); empty = the region it stands in.

properties.name: moveParent
properties.doc: Move the parent along the path (a CharacterMover, a DynamicBody or any node); off: read `velocity` in a script.

properties.name: avoidance
properties.doc: Steer away from other agents (their radius).

properties.name: velocity
properties.doc: The velocity it wants this frame (px/s; read-only).

nodes.name: Path Follow
nodes.description: Travels along its parent Path (or a Vector Shape's outline): speed, loop / ping-pong / stop, faces the way it goes. Put a sprite, a platform or an enemy under it.

properties.name: progress
properties.doc: Distance travelled along the parent path (px). Set it to place the follower; scripts can animate it.

properties.name: speed
properties.doc: Pixels per second it moves along the path by itself (negative: backwards; 0: only scripts move it).

properties.name: loop
properties.doc: At the end: Stop (path_finished), Loop (start again) or Ping Pong (turn back).

properties.name: rotate
properties.doc: Turn to face the direction it travels.

properties.name: sideOffset
properties.doc: Pixels to the side of the path (positive: to the right of the travel direction) - lanes, offsets.

nodes.name: LDtk Tilemap Level
nodes.description: Full LDtk level renderer for grid-based tile layers, auto-layering, and entity placement.

properties.name: enablePhysics
properties.doc: Build colliders from IntGrid cells whose collision rule is Solid / One Way.

properties.name: spawnEntities
properties.doc: Spawn the level's entities (mapped to components) when ready.

properties.name: parallax
properties.doc: Apply the LDtk layers' parallax factors.

properties.name: drawBackground
properties.doc: Draw the level's background colour / image.

properties.name: drawEntityTiles
properties.doc: Draw entities' LDtk tiles (editor visuals for unspawned entities).

properties.name: tintColor
properties.doc: Multiplies every layer's colours.

properties.name: drawDebugColliders

properties.doc: Make the joint springy instead of rigid.

properties.name: joint.distance.hertz
properties.doc: Spring stiffness as an oscillation frequency (Hz); 0 = no spring.

properties.name: joint.distance.dampingRatio
properties.doc: Spring damping: 0 bounces forever, 1 settles without overshoot.

properties.name: joint.distance.enableLimit

properties.name: joint.distance.maxMotorForce

properties.name: joint.distance.motorSpeed

properties.name: joint.distance.collideConnected

properties.name: joint.motor.angularOffset

properties.name: joint.motor.maxForce

properties.name: joint.motor.maxTorque

properties.doc: Round joints and caps.

nodes.name: Vector Shape
nodes.description: Vector art from an SVG (Inkscape, Illustrator, Affinity, Figma) or a built-in shape: crisp at any zoom, anti-aliased, cached on the GPU.

properties.name: file
properties.doc: The SVG it draws (project path); empty: the preset. Reloads when the file is saved.

properties.name: group
properties.doc: A symbol: draw only this named group of the file (Inkscape layer, Illustrator group; "a/b" for nested). Empty: the whole file.

properties.name: frame
properties.doc: Part swapping: show only this child group of the group (mouths, hands, eyes); -1 shows them all. Key it for frame-by-frame.

properties.name: preset
properties.doc: The built-in shape it draws when it has no file.

properties.name: fillColor
properties.doc: The shape's fill colour.

properties.name: strokeColor
properties.doc: The outline's colour.

properties.name: strokeWidth
properties.doc: Outline thickness (px, in the shape's own scale); 0 = no outline.

properties.name: tint
properties.doc: Multiplies the texture's colours (white = unchanged; alpha fades it).

properties.name: brightness
properties.doc: Darken (-1 black) or lighten (1 white) the art (Flash's brightness effect).

properties.name: colorAdd
properties.doc: A colour added to the art's colours (Flash's advanced colour offset): flash white on a hit, tint toward a colour.

properties.name: trimStart
properties.doc: Trim paths: where along each path drawing starts (0..1 of its length). Key Start / End for draw-on lines.

properties.name: trimEnd
properties.doc: Trim paths: where along each path drawing stops (1 = the end; 0.5 draws the first half).

properties.name: trimOffset
properties.doc: Trim paths: moves the drawn part along the path, wrapping round (animate it for a running dash).

properties.name: trimEach
properties.doc: Trim every subpath on its own (a ring's circles drawn on together) instead of one after another.

properties.name: morphTo
properties.doc: Shape tween: another group of the same file to morph into (Flash's shape tweens).

properties.name: morph
properties.doc: Shape tween: 0 draws the group, 1 draws Morph To, between interpolates paths, colours, outlines and gradients. Key it.

properties.name: lineScale
properties.doc: Scale: outlines get thicker / thinner with the node's scale. Constant: they keep their width (Flash's line scaling None).

properties.name: shadowColor
properties.doc: Drop shadow filter: its colour (alpha 0: no shadow). Filters draw the art through a texture remade only when it changes.

properties.name: shadowOffset
properties.doc: Drop shadow: how far the shadow sits from the art (screen px).

properties.name: shadowBlur
properties.doc: Drop shadow: how soft its edge is (screen px).

properties.name: glowColor
properties.doc: Glow filter: an outer glow's colour (alpha 0: no glow).

properties.name: glowSize
properties.doc: Glow: how far it spreads (screen px).

properties.name: glowStrength
properties.doc: Glow: how strong it is (1 = the blurred coverage; more: brighter, harder).

properties.name: outlineColor
properties.doc: Outline filter: a line round the whole drawing (cel-shading, selection); alpha 0: none.

properties.name: outlineWidth
properties.doc: Outline: its thickness (screen px).

properties.name: blur
properties.doc: Blur filter: blurs the art itself (screen px); 0 = sharp.

properties.name: saturation
properties.doc: Colour filter: 0 grey, 1 as drawn, 2 vivid.

properties.name: contrast
properties.doc: Colour filter: 1 as drawn; less: flatter, more: punchier.

properties.name: hue
properties.doc: Colour filter: turns the colours round the colour wheel (degrees).

properties.name: skinBones
properties.doc: Vector skinning: the bones of a Skeleton above it that the art bends with ("upper, lower"; "*" = all; empty = none). Bound in the skeleton's setup pose.

properties.name: skinSmooth
properties.doc: Vector skinning: how far round each joint (px) neighbouring bones blend - 0 makes rigid parts, 30-60 bends a limb round a soft elbow.

properties.name: warpTopLeft
properties.doc: Four-corner warp (squash and stretch): how far the art's top-left corner moves (px); the art stretches between the corners. Key it.

properties.name: warpTopRight
properties.doc: Four-corner warp: how far the top-right corner moves (px).

properties.name: warpBottomLeft
properties.doc: Four-corner warp: how far the bottom-left corner moves (px).

properties.name: warpBottomRight
properties.doc: Four-corner warp: how far the bottom-right corner moves (px).

properties.name: collider
properties.doc: Collision from the art: Solid makes convex pieces (any body), Outline edge loops (smooth terrain). On the Body above it, or a static body of its own.

properties.name: colliderDetail
properties.doc: How closely the collider follows the art (its units): bigger means fewer corners, faster physics.

properties.name: colliderFriction
properties.doc: The collider's friction (0 ice ... 1 rubber).

properties.name: colliderBounce
properties.doc: The collider's restitution (0 no bounce ... 1 full bounce).

properties.name: colliderDensity
